name: smart-queue
description: Smart Queue — Smart Queue Token Management System with DevOps

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const port=3000;const mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'application/javascript','json':'application/json','svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.slice(1);let p=path.join(__dirname,f);if(fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.statSync(p).isFile()){let ext=path.extname(p).slice(1);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}}).listen(port,()=>console.log('Smart Queue local server running at http://localhost:'+port));"

author: Smart Queue DevOps Team
